run_get_nearest_times: run get_nearest_times to find the closest discretization time points for each value in a time grid tensor
test_get_nearest_times: test get_nearest_times by passing a time grid tensor and a discretization tensor and verifying nearest indices
review_get_nearest_times: review get_nearest_times which uses torch.cdist to compute Euclidean distances between time grid and discretization tensors
summarize_get_nearest_times: summarize get_nearest_times that maps each time grid value to its nearest point in a discretization tensor
refactor_get_nearest_times: refactor get_nearest_times to support batched time grid inputs or alternative distance metrics
